notes.title: EYES ON THE EXAM available July 8th!!!
notes.content: [p][b]GOOD NEWS CLASS!!![/b][/p][p][/p][p]EYES ON THE EXAM is coming to Steam a bit earlier than expected! The release date is now [b]July 8th[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]Also, I'm happy to announce that EYES ON THE EXAM will be available for [b]only $4.99[/b] and the prices will follow the recommended regional pricing so everyone can have a fun time (and a little scary one too) regardless of their currency.[/p][p][/p][p]If you have played the demo here's a list of features that will include the final version of the game that weren't included in the demo:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]45 different questions that will appear in random order (instead of 10 always in the same order)[/p][/*][*][p]More elements to interact around the classroom[/p][/*][*][p]3 different endings to unlock[/p][/*][*][p]A more challenging teacher with better reflexes[/p][/*][*][p]Achievements[/p][/*][*][p]Game controller support (also working on Steamdeck validation)[/p][/*][*][p]Many secrets and hidden lore to uncover! [/p][/*][/list][p]Oh, and also, EYES ON THE EXAM will be available in six different languages at launch:[/p][list][*][p]English[/p][/*][*][p]Spanish[/p][/*][*][p]Chinese[/p][/*][*][p]Russian[/p][/*][*][p]French[/p][/*][*][p]Portuguese[/p][/*][/list][p]If your language isn't listed, don't worry. After launch, I'll be adding as many languages ​​as time and resources allow.[/p][p][/p][p]Take care and see you soon in class![/p][p][/p]
